definitions.explanation: Something that has never happened or existed before. Literally means 'empty before' — nothing like it has come before. Often used with の as a modifier.

examples.japanese: {空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|だい}ヒット→大ヒット：20827_daihitto⟧だ。
{空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was held on an unprecedented scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空前|くうぜん}{絶後|ぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This anime boasts unprecedented popularity, with fans continuing to grow worldwide.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (empty/void) + ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before) — literally "nothing before it." Very commonly paired with {絶後|ぜつご} (nothing after) to form the four-character idiom {空前|くうぜん}{絶後|ぜつご} (literally "nothing before, nothing after"), meaning completely unprecedented and unrepeatable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|だい}ヒット→大ヒット：20827_daihitto⟧: unprecedented mega-hit
- {空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧: unprecedented scale
- {空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧: unprecedented boom/craze
- {空前|くうぜん}{絶後|ぜつご}: unprecedented and unrepeatable
- {空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ: record-breaking sales

USAGE:
Typically used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier before nouns ({空前|くうぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜). Has a positive or neutral connotation, often describing achievements, popularity, or scale rather than disasters.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧: unprecedented — tends toward negative or shocking events
- ⟦{未曾有|みぞう}→未曾有：21108_mizou⟧: unprecedented — often used for disasters or crises
- ⟦{史上|しじょう}{初|はつ}→史上初：29093_shijouhatsu⟧: first in history — more factual/objective
